content_sections.heading: About BNU
content_sections.text: Bengaluru North University has its Administrative Office at Sri Devaraj Urs Extension, Tamka, Kolar - 563 103, in Karnataka. The Registrar issued this notification with the approval of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor dated 21 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: BNU Super Skilled Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will perform technical work in various sections of the university's Administrative Office. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: BNU Super Skilled Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification: BE (Computer Science)/ M.Sc (Computer Science). The notice also says candidates should possess a degree in the relevant subject. Experience: 02 Years or above 02 Years. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The printed opening date is the same as the notification date and falls before the last date.

rows.event: Submitted application will be opened (as printed)

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are temporary and are to be filled for the academic year 2026-27. The place of work is Bengaluru North University, Administrative Office, Tamaka, Kolar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BNU Super Skilled Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Bengaluru North University website . Complete the form. Attach the documents listed below. Submit the application to The Registrar, Bengaluru North University Administrative Office, Sri Devaraj Urs Layout, Tamaka, Kolar - 563103. Documents to attach, in two copies: Mark sheets Degree certificates Experience certificates Other required documents

faq.question: Q1. How much experience is needed for the Super Skilled Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for 02 Years or above 02 Years of experience, and experience certificates must be sent with the application.

faq.question: Q2. Will a late application be accepted?
faq.answer: No. The notice says late applications will not be considered after 5:00 PM on the last date.

faq.question: Q3. How many copies of the documents are required?
faq.answer: The notice asks for the documents in two copies.

faq.question: Q4. What work will a Super Skilled Assistant do?
faq.answer: The post involves technical work in various sections of the Administrative Office at Tamaka, Kolar.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes these as temporary posts for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q6. How can I contact the university?
faq.answer: The letterhead gives the telephone numbers 08152 243152/53.
